title: Rosemary Beach "Birdhouse" 36 Town Hall
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located in the heart of Rosemary Beach, just a few blocks from the beach- Professionally designed- Outdoor dining area- Media room- Wet bar- Loggia- Grill - 3 adult bikes- 2 dedicated parking spots- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Get away from it all in Rosemary Beach. "Birdhouse" is a charming 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom perfectly located in the heart of Rosemary Beach, south of 30A, and just a few blocks to the beach. It's professionally built and designed by renowned architect, Julia Starr Sanford. There are wonderful opportunities for enjoying the outdoors on all levels of the home, including a courtyard and covered terrace. The first floor of the home has a media room and wet bar near the entrance, accompanied by 2 spacious guest rooms. The first features a queen bed with a private entrance, attached bathroom, and flat-screen TV. The other bedroom has 2 twin day beds with attached trundles and a private bathroom. Cathedral ceilings made of wood beams frame the second floor, where guests can find an open kitchen and living room. The kitchen features premium Wolf stainless steel appliances to make cooking and food prep a breeze. And if you prefer to feel the Gulf breeze, beautiful French doors open up to a sprawling second-floor balcony across the room. There is seating for 9 at the breakfast bar and formal dining table. There is also additional outdoor seating on the covered balcony for the perfect al fresco dinner setting. The master bedroom is located off of the kitchen and includes a king bed, ensuite with a jacuzzi tub, and private entrance to the balcony with French doors. A private courtyard on the ground floor separates the main house to the loggia. The footpath leads to a small fountain surrounded by tall trees and greenery, giving off a true sense of harmony that balances out the home. The loggia has 2 lounge chaises and overlooks the neighborhood. It's the perfect spot to read a book or get a moment of peaceful reflection. Guests will have access to the Rosemary Beach pools throughout the neighborhood as well as 3 adult bikes. Don't miss your chance to stay at the "Birdhouse" and book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 6):FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Daybeds with Twin Trundles, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower and TubYou also have access to these fantastic Rosemary Beach amenities:- Coquina Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.- Sky Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 6 am to 10 pm (Adult Only Hours, 6 am-9 am & 8 pm-10 pm)- Cabana Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm. - Barbados Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm. Parties, weddings, or events held at the property must be pre-approved in writing by 360 Blue. Otherwise, guests will be subject to HOA, community, and other associated fines.
